name: Ruby
exports_detected: class and module declarations (always public at namespace level)
description: 🔴 Tracks public/private visibility as it scans. Methods before a private marker are public. initialize excluded.

detection_rules.title: Class and module declarations
detection_rules.description: class and module names starting with an uppercase letter are always captured as public namespace-level exports.
detection_rules.example_code:
module Authentication
  class AuthService
  end
end

class _InternalHelper  # still captured: class names start with uppercase

detection_rules.title: Visibility-tracked methods
detection_rules.description: Methods after a bare private or protected keyword are excluded. Methods before, or after a bare public keyword, are included. initialize is always excluded.
detection_rules.example_code:
class Foo
  def public_one; end   # included
  def public_two; end   # included

  private

  def secret_one; end   # excluded

  public

  def public_again; end # included

  protected

  def also_hidden; end  # excluded
end

detection_rules.title: Constants
detection_rules.description: Any uppercase-only constant assignment (NAME = value) is captured.

detection_rules.title: attr_accessor / attr_reader / attr_writer
detection_rules.description: Attribute declarations extract the symbol names as separate exports.

module: auth
version: 1
status: stable
files:
  - lib/auth/service.rb
---

## Purpose

Ruby auth service with JWT validation.

## Public API

| Symbol | Kind | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `Authentication` | module | Auth namespace |
| `AuthService` | class | Auth service class |
| `validate` | method | Validates a JWT token |
| `DEFAULT_TTL` | constant | Default TTL in seconds |
| `token` | attr_reader | Token accessor |

## Change Log

| Date | Change |
|------|--------|
| 2026-01-01 | Initial |
example_source:
module Authentication
  class AuthService
    DEFAULT_TTL = 3600

    attr_reader :token, :expires_at

    def validate(token)
      !token.nil? && !token.empty?
    end

    def self.create(config)
      new(config)
    end

    private

    def internal_check
      # internal
    end
  end
end
caveats: Visibility tracking resets at the start of each class/module scope; nested classes start as public again.
Method aliases (alias_method :new_name, :old_name) are not captured as additional exports.
Dynamic method definitions (define_method :name do ... end) are not detected.
Rails-specific DSL exports (has_many, belongs_to, scope, etc.) are not captured.
